text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After running errands with Eishin Flash, we head toward one last location.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Here is the inn that's hosting the immersive lecture on Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Learn from the past, as they say! Learning about time-honored traditions should help me deepen my understanding of modern trends!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash has become determined to learn all about the newest trends in Japanese culture after singing karaoke with her friend the other day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And to facilitate that, we're attending a lecture on Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Here is a typical guest room at this inn.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I just recalled that there is specific etiquette for walking into a Japanese-style room.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: My, aren't you well-informed? You must be talking about how one shouldn't step on the cracks between the tatami mats.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I very nearly did just that. I shall be more cautious from now on.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Please, there is no need to be nervous. Relax and enjoy the tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Eishin Flash remains on high alert as the tour goes on, until…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised that all the hot water must be replaced every time they clean. From a cost-efficiency standpoint, that seems rather wasteful…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But it is important to prioritize the health and safety of guests, and that's a fantastic way to keep everything hygienic.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I can't believe they are able to serve meals so punctually despite how many rooms there are here…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This is the true epitome of time management. I take my hat off to them!

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: That concludes today's lecture. What did you think?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was marvelous beyond words. In fact, I would love to take an even more in-depth tour.
choice_data_list: Sounds like you really enjoyed yourself!
Sounds like you really enjoyed yourself!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I did. Traditional Japanese hospitality—"omotenashi" truly is exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Being provided a traditional yukata as sleepwear is also a valuable experience from a cultural perspective.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Above all, every element of this facility works in harmony to make guests feel at home.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now, I'm painfully aware that everything I thought I knew about Japanese-style inns was superficial at best.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I still have much to learn… It seems a shame to depart while I am still so ignorant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash seems reluctant to leave. In that case…
choice_data_list: Would you like to stay here overnight sometime?
Would you like to ask the hostess some questions?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That is an intriguing suggestion. I could certainly learn much more if I actually spent a night here.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Oh, we would be honored to have you! There's plenty to enjoy here.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: First, there's our wonderful hot spring where you can wash away your fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Then in the evening, our chefs prepare dinner using plenty of fresh, seasonal ingredients. You can enjoy your meal in your room.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Should you visit us in the summer, you could watch fireworks light up the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: W-wonderful! I shall make a summer reservation right now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Weren't you going to make a reservation?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ohne Fleiß kein Preis. There is no gain without pain.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In other words… I shall begin saving money.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If I reduce my budget for baking ingredients by 20%, I should be able to stay here… in precisely three years, six months' time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like booking a room here isn't cheap. But at least Eishin Flash now has a new goal to strive toward.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: You wish to know more? In that case, I would recommend you attend our immersive housekeeping seminar.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh! I would love to attend that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion. Thank you for staying with us today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If there is anything we can provide to make your stay more comfortable, please don't hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Well done! ♪ That was a picture-perfect greeting.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. However… sitting on my knees for so long is quite painful…

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a difficult position to maintain if you're not accustomed to it. I remember struggling with it too when I first became a hostess.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hm… Both learning and traditions are cultivated through the accumulation of experiences.

text_block_list.name: Hostess
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That is exactly how traditions are built.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The building of tradition… Thank you very much. This was most informative.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash's eyes glitter with newfound joy and knowledge as she thanks the hostess for her time.
